It was played on 11 May 2022 between [[Juventus FC|Juventus]] and [[Inter Milan|Internazionale]].{{cite web |url=https://www.worldfootball.net/competition/ro118417/md0/results-and-standings/|title=2022 Coppa Italia Final|work=World Football|access-date=19 April 2022|date=19 April 2022}} Internazionale won the match 4–2 after [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]] for their eighth Coppa Italia title.{{cite web|url=https://football-italia.net/coppa-italia-final-juventus-2-4-inter-aet-thrilling-nerazzurri-triumph/|title=Coppa Italia Final – Juventus 2-4 Inter aet: Thrilling Nerazzurri Triumph|website=Football Italia|date=11 May 2022|access-date=11 May 2022}}{{cite web|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/61413085|title=Juventus 2–4 Inter Milan: Inter come from behind to win first Coppa Italia since 2011|website=BBC Sport|date=11 May 2022|access-date=11 May 2022}} As winners, they qualified for the [[2022 Supercoppa Italiana]] against the champions of the [[2021–22 Serie A]]. ==Background== This was the third [[Derby d'Italia]] in a Coppa Italia final, after [[1959 Coppa Italia Final|1959]] and [[1965 Coppa Italia Final|1965]], both won by Juventus. This was the fourth derby of the 2021–22 season, with one league draw and two wins for Internazionale, including the [[2021 Supercoppa Italiana]]. ==Road to the final== ''Note: In all results below, the score of the finalist is given first (H: home; A: away).'' {| width="100%" style="text-align:center" |- valign=top bgcolor=#99ccff !colspan=2 style="width:40%"|[[Juventus FC|Juventus]] !Round !colspan=2 style="width:40%"|[[Inter Milan|Internazionale]] |- valign=top bgcolor=#c1e0ff |Opponent |Result |bgcolor=#c1e0ff|[[2021–22 Coppa Italia]] |Opponent |Result |- |[[U.C.
